sections.Lead: Ethan William Childress is an American actor. He is best known for playing Johan Johnson in Mixed-ish and voicing Rowley Jefferson in Diary of a Wimpy Kid.
sections.Early life: Childress was born in Las Vegas, Nevada. He got interested in acting after his parents enrolled him in a charter school for the arts. While he enjoys acting, he is hoping to get a business degree from college.
sections.Career: Childress' first big role of his acting career came voicing Rowley Jefferson in the animated reboot film Diary of a Wimpy Kid. He rose to fame starring as Johan Johnson in the sitcom Mixed-ish. He reprised his role voicing Rowley in Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Rodrick Rules (2022 film). In the future, Childress hopes to work with Will Smith and Daveed Diggs.
sections.Personal life: Outside of acting, Childress likes to play sports, play video games, do jiu-jitsu, go swimming, hang out with his friends and go to the movies.
